# Teo Customs Paint & Body

> Auto body and paint shop in Southside Richmond, Virginia (Hull Street Road corridor, near the Chesterfield County line). Collision repair, paint matching, full paint jobs and color changes, custom paint, wide-body and aero installs, chrome deletes, classic truck restoration work and welding. Owner Teo Vasquez is I-CAR certified in welding and auto body repair. Rated 5.0 on Google from 121 reviews. Open 7 days.

## Business facts
- Name: Teo Customs Paint & Body (also shown as "Teo Customs" and "Teo X Customs Paint and Body")
- Type: Auto body shop (collision repair, paint and custom body work)
- Owner: Teo Vasquez, I-CAR certified in welding and auto body repair
- Recognition: "TOP GUN Business Professional", County Advisory Board
- Address: 5255 Hull Street Rd N #14, Richmond, VA 23224, United States
- Area: Southside Richmond, Hull Street corridor, near the Chesterfield County line
- Coordinates: 37.490709, -77.489462
- Phone and text: (804) 852-2954
- Email: teo_customs@outlook.com
- Website: https://teocustomsrva.com/
- Google rating: 5.0 stars from 121 reviews

## Services
- Collision repair, including parking-lot hits
- Bumper repair and custom fit
- Door repair
- Scratch and dent repair
- Headlight repair and refurbishing
- Welding
- Paint matching
- Full paint jobs and color changes
- Custom paint
- Body kits and wide-body installs
- Spoiler, front splitter and wing installs
- Chrome deletes and trim
- Restoration work (classic trucks and older cars)
- Insurance claim repairs: "We'll work with your insurance."

## Pricing
- No published price list. Every job is quoted after the damage is seen. The fastest way to get a quote is to send photos.

## How to get an estimate or book
- Photo estimate form: https://teocustomsrva.com/estimate.html
- Call or text photos: (804) 852-2954
- Email: teo_customs@outlook.com
- Call or text ahead before visiting so Teo can make time to look at the vehicle.

## Payment and accessibility
- Credit cards, debit cards, NFC mobile pay
- Wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking

## FAQ
- Do you work with insurance companies? Yes. Teo Customs will work with your insurance company on collision claims and keeps you updated through the process.
- How do I get an estimate? Send photos through the estimate form at https://teocustomsrva.com/estimate.html or text them to (804) 852-2954.
- How much will my repair cost? It depends on the damage, parts and paint involved; each job is quoted after the damage is seen.
- What are the hours? Open 7 days: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 8 AM - 5 PM; Wed 8 AM - 5:30 PM; Sat 9 AM - 5 PM; Sun 9 AM - 5:30 PM.
- Where is the shop, and is there parking? 5255 Hull Street Rd N #14, Richmond, VA 23224, with wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking.
- Do I need an appointment? Call or text (804) 852-2954 before coming in; sending photos first is the quickest way to start.
- Can you match factory paint? Yes, paint matching is part of every repair.
- Do you do custom work? Yes: wide-body kits, spoilers, splitters, wings, chrome deletes, color changes and custom paint.
- What payment is accepted? Credit and debit cards and NFC mobile pay.
- Is the owner certified? Yes. Teo Vasquez is I-CAR certified in welding and auto body repair.
